AULA S87 Tri-Mode Wireless Gasket Mechanical Keyboard (84 Keys Layout / Hot-Swappable / Gasket-Mounted Structure / HIFI Acoustics Sound / Dynamic RGB)

Experience premium typing comfort and acoustic excellence with the AULA S87 Tri-Mode Wireless Gasket Mechanical Keyboard, now available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring a space-saving 84-key layout configuration, this high-performance keyboard is engineered with a true Gasket-Mounted structural design layout. Enhanced with multiple layers of sound-dampening foam matrix, it delivers a satisfyingly clean HIFI acoustics signature profile with every single click. The S87 provides absolute freedom with its full Hot-Swappable PCB layout, allowing you to easily swap 3-pin or 5-pin switches without soldering. Built for ultimate versatility, it features Tri-Mode connectivity ecosystem parameters—seamlessly transitioning between ultra-low latency 2.4GHz wireless, stable Bluetooth wireless, and reliable USB-C wired modes across PC, Mac, and mobile setups. Wrapped in a stunning customizable dynamic RGB backlighting system framework, this mechanical masterpiece delivers the ultimate hybrid response for competitive gaming and extended productivity sessions.
